The '''E-Web(15) Heavy Repeating Blaster''' was manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], and was a modified version of their standard [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]]. Released the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], the E-Web(15) was a two-man weapon that could be "quick-mounted" on a [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]], allowing it to be set up and operational in under five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]<ref name="LCS" /> using the attached generator's "autoconfigure" setting.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The weapon drew power from a high-demand portable [[Eksoan/Legends|Eksoan]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] with an inbuilt [[Gk7 Cryocooler/Legends|Gk7 Cryocooler]] [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]]. The Gk7 was an improvement over the [[Gk3 Cryocooler]], boasting greater efficiency and higher resistance to the damaging effects of high [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] zones. Newer models were also outfitted with a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] to protect the Cryocooler unit.<ref name="LCS" />
